# The invariant catalog

Every invariant family enforced on the engine, discovered from the
tree (family markers in `tests/engine`, assert ids and diagnosis
codes in `src/engine`) and linked to its enforcing tests. An
invariant with no resolving test fails generation unless it is a
frozen, visible entry in the known-gaps register below — that is
the K8 gate's teeth (`tests/engine/test_engine_book.py`).

The *enforced by* column lists every test file carrying the id's
marker — the defining suite plus any suite that cross-references
it (bare single-letter markers are file-level attributions).

## M-family — Metamorphic suite (algebraic relations, no oracles)

| invariant | meaning | defined in | enforced by |
